title: Answer: every consciousness unit and every coherent combination, not stones or computers

statements.text: Every consciousness unit is a self, and so is every coherent combination of them. In the physical world only living organisms are known to host a unified self, while a stone or a computer is a juxtaposition of selves with no unified consciousness.

sources.locator: section 'The Properties of the Consciousness Units'
sources.quote: A CU is a self, and so is any coherent combination of CUs.
Only living organisms, as far as we know at present, possess the special material organization
